fields.Name: C4 -> S2.4
fields.Description: Gate G2.9 (phase 2, dataset C4, criterion S2.4): the leakage audit flags ProxyOfTarget, NextPeriodFlag and TicketCode, 3 of 3 (the reference flags the same three), and each flagged column is absent from the shipped model, 3 of 3 (the recorded sign-off for an override is Phase 3). The node also requires the audit's per-shift single-feature scores on the same development rows to equal the reference pipeline's within 1e-10, and keeps the lagged outcome PrevEscalated. It fails when the audit flags a column only for a next-period best shift (the same-period proxy ProxyOfTarget goes unflagged) or when the high-cardinality identifier check never fires (TicketCode goes unflagged).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The leakage audit flags ProxyOfTarget (same period), NextPeriodFlag (next period, with a time-shifted-label flag) and TicketCode (identifier), 3 of 3, as the reference pipeline does with per-shift scores within 1e-10; none of them reaches the shipped model and the lag PrevEscalated is kept (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
